# Shell command execution with input surface

Several methods spawn git subprocesses with largely user-supplied arguments (like branch, commit, paths). Malicious or malformed repository state or arguments could produce unexpected behavior or errors, though Python's subprocess does not invoke the shell unless explicitly requested.
